verdicts.reason: Both quotes appear verbatim: the Folkhälsomyndigheten page says NVR is a health data register the agency is responsible for, and SFS 2012:453 § 1 names '(vaccinationsregistret)' in Folkhälsomyndighetens verksamhet. Name and responsible body match as printed.

The page states verbatim that Myndigheten för civilt försvar 'ansvarar för drift, förvaltning och utveckling av Rakel'. This supports the operator of Rakel (public-safety radio); the page says nothing about 112 emergency-call handling, which the class heading also covers.

The page names Rakel as 'Sveriges nationella kommunikationssystem för ledning och samverkan' for actors in public order, security, health and defence, which supports the system name and the 'national public-safety communication system' gloss. The word 'radio' does not appear anywhere on the page, so that descriptor is not stated by the source.

The Riksbank page contains the quote verbatim and elsewhere says 'RIX-systemet har två avvecklingstjänster; RIX-RTGS och RIX-INST. RIX-RTGS är för stora betalningar', which supports RIX-RTGS as the Riksbank's large-value settlement system.
Folkbokföringsdatalag (2026:126) § 2 is quoted verbatim and places folkbokföring within Skatteverkets folkbokföringsverksamhet, matching the printed name and holder.
2 kap. 1 § of förordning 1993:1153 is on the page verbatim: 'Varje högskola ska föra ett studieregister', which is exactly the printed statement.

The page is titled 'Förordning (2016:1023) med instruktion för Ekonomistyrningsverket' and § 4 reads verbatim 'Myndigheten ska 1. ansvara för statsredovisningen', so ESV being responsible for state accounts is stated.

§ 15 of ESV's instruction ordinance is quoted verbatim: the agency shall 'utveckla och förvalta statens informationssystem för budgetering, hantering av dokument och uppföljning (Hermes)', matching the printed name and role.
§ 5 of lag 2021:1187 appears verbatim: Polismyndigheten and Migrationsverket are each personuppgiftsansvarig for the processing they perform in the Swedish national part of SIS, exactly as printed.
§ 4 appears verbatim: Polismyndigheten shall keep a register that is the Swedish national part of Schengens informationssystem, which is the printed statement.

Vägtrafikdatalag 2 kap. 1 § is on the page verbatim ('Uppgiftssamlingen benämns vägtrafikregistret', registered by Transportstyrelsen), and the Transportstyrelsen page quote also appears verbatim; both support the register name and keeper.
Vallagen 5 kap. 1 § appears verbatim: the central election authority draws up a röstlängd per valdistrikt, based on data in Skatteverkets folkbokföringsverksamhet, matching the printed statement.
The SCB page's 2026-08-21 statistical news says verbatim 'Vid halvårsskiftet 2026 var 10 610 500 personer folkbokförda i landet', the same figure, unit and date as printed.

The page says verbatim that Skatteverket is responsible for operation, development and monitoring of the IT support on behalf of Valmyndigheten, and adds that it was built in-house by Valmyndigheten with Skatteverket; that supports 'national' rather than an EU or non-EU provider. Note the page also states the physical location is withheld for secrecy reasons.
The quote appears verbatim: after manual counting the result 'läggs ... in i Valmyndighetens it-stöd för att sammanställas och kommuniceras till allmänheten', which is the printed statement.

The quote is on the page, but it concerns Valmyndighetens valadministrativa it-stöd (ballot ordering, voting cards, result reporting); the page never says the röstlängd is kept or produced in that system, mentioning the roll only as a limited 2026 feature for digitally marking received votes. Whether the electoral roll's infrastructure is the one Skatteverket operates is not stated by this source.
